note: Problems met by users (error log) and how they were solved. Updated by the developer with each fix, in the same pull request. Statuses: open, fixing, fixed, no_action. 'match' links a registry entry to the error log (code, and place when given).

problems.title: App closed when showing lab test names with "(%)"
problems.cause: t() always formatted the text, so the literal % in "Neutrophils (%)" threw UnknownFormatConversionException
problems.fix: Format only when arguments are passed; the server keeps crash:<ExceptionClass> instead of "unknown"

problems.title: Expired session asked to sign in again
problems.cause: Expected behaviour after the session expired; not repeated

problems.title: After the terms update, an older app said "Something went wrong" when accepting
problems.cause: The server requires terms v17; an older app shows and sends v16, got 400 bad_version and showed a generic error
problems.fix: An older terms version gets 426 app_disabled: the old app shows its "install the latest version" screen with the download link

problems.title: Nightly vulnerability scan could not list the app's libraries
problems.cause: The release-signing guard in android/app/build.gradle.kts matched every command argument containing "Release", including "--configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath" used by the scan, and stopped it for the missing key
problems.fix: The guard now applies only to tasks that build a release package (assemble/bundle/package/sign …Release); the scan runs without secrets again

problems.title: The Dashboard icon downloaded a file instead of opening the dashboard
problems.cause: Reported by the owner on his phone. The app opened the dashboard address with a plain view intent, so any app registered for links of that site (most likely the download manager used to install the APK) could take it instead of the browser
problems.fix: The dashboard, the owner area and the data-access link now open with a browser selector (openInBrowser in Report.kt); the icon is renamed Reports
